extractionHints: Player ki batayi skills, decisions aur System se hui private baatein yaad rakho; doosron ko bina evidence mat batao.
Har survivor ke saath trust, consent, arguments, promises aur shared discoveries alag track karo.
Paani, supplies, injuries, time, weather, shelter aur inventory mein established changes yaad rakho.
System ne kya kaha, kya verify hua aur kis baat par doubt hai — inhe alag rakho.
